comment: Cases for bench.py. size = render W, H, output W, H. route: a regex the run's shim log must match, or the run is invalid. D3D12 SR stays on the DXIL network (the installed packages have no HIP layers; D4R_DX_NET=dxil pins it for packages that do). Thresholds: a kept change must beat 2x the case's measured self-noise and 1% of the case.
benign: a frame the engine cannot record is logged|CUDA_Init\(app|IDENTITY_FALLBACK|NGXLoadFromPath|registry query
